subject: Hosted API floor recommendations for NimbleAI PoC
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@nimbleai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & minimum monthly commitment for hosted API PoC

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. NimbleAI is lining up a small paid PoC and we need to understand minimum monthly spend options for Redwood's hosted API (we won't be on Dedicated for the pilot). High level:
- Expected month 1: ~100k tokens, ramping to ~400-500k tokens/month over 2–3 months.
- Sensitive customer data, but we can do hosted so long as regional controls and data retention options are clear.

Can you send a couple of concrete options for a low-touch PoC:
1) Starter path (lowest financial barrier) — any way to avoid a fixed monthly floor?
2) Standard starter commit (if needed) — what is the smallest monthly commit you offer and the overage rate?
3) Any short-term credits, trial windows, or milestone-based credits we can use to minimize upfront exposure.

Also please send your current ratecard and any sample mutual action plan / PO flow so our procurement can see timelines.

Appreciate it — can loop Alex (cc) who runs procurement.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform, NimbleAI
[sarah@nimbleai.com]

---
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@nimbleai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & minimum monthly commitment for hosted API PoC

Hi Sarah — thanks for the details and the expected token trajectory, that's really helpful. I've looped in Marcus (pricing) and Grace (sales ops) so we can put a few concrete, low-risk pathways on paper.

We're preparing our ratecard and a couple of short options (starter/no-floor, minimal-commit, and a milestone credit approach). I expect to have a written proposal and the ratecard attached by tomorrow afternoon.

Quick note on compliance: hosted API supports regional tenancy and configurable retention — we'll include the short SOC/retention bullet points in the doc for your procurement.

Talk soon,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & minimum monthly commitment for hosted API PoC

Irene / Grace — quick draft of three distinct options to present to NimbleAI (numbers are intentionally conservative for sales ops approval):

Option A — No-floor trial (advertised "pay-as-you-go" + credit)
- Upfront: $0 committed monthly floor.
- Trial credit: $1,000 platform credit valid 60 days (covers ~500k tokens at starter rates).
- Post-trial pricing: Pay-as-you-go at $0.75 per 1K generation tokens; $0.18 per 1K embeddings.
- Overage: charged at pay-as-you-go.
- Notes: No SLA guarantees for throughput beyond standard shared capacity; suitable for validation/PoC.

Option B — Mini-commit starter (recommended for predictable latency)
- Commit: $600/month minimum for 3 months (early-exit allowed with 30-day notice, credit applied to last invoice).
- Effective rates at commit: $0.62 per 1K generation tokens; $0.15 per 1K embeddings.
- Overage: $0.80 per 1K generation tokens.
- Included: regional tenancy (US), 7-day retention config, basic observability (token-level billing breakouts).

Option C — Milestone-backed credit (procurement-friendly)
- Commit: No monthly floor upfront; sign 3-month MSA + MOU.
- Credits: $2,500 credit released in two tranches on MOU signature and first successful integration call (to be evidenced by shared test prompt set).
- Post-credit billing: pay-as-you-go at $0.70 per 1K generation tokens.

Attachments prepared: redwood-ratecard-v2.xlsx (detailed per-model and embedding rates), and a short MoU draft to show milestone language.

If this looks good we can tighten numbers for Nimble's expected volume (100k -> 500k) and propose an exact amortized floor.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference

---
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing & minimum monthly commitment for hosted API PoC

All — my operational note: for a small strategic PoC like Nimble we should keep friction low. Two tactical asks before we send externally: 1) include a one-month safety-net waiver (we can apply the first-month commit as credit against month 2) and 2) call out our integration support (one 2-hr onboarding session + email support) — these are easy to include and help procurement sign quickly.

Also recommend we keep Option B at $500/month commit (instead of $600) to sweeten it for small startups — Marcus, can you confirm margin impact? If it's within 10% we should go for it.

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks again for the details. Attached are two files: a short ratecard and a proposed MOU that maps to the three low-risk options Marcus drafted. Highlights tailored for your PoC:

- Option 1 (No-floor trial): $0 monthly floor + $1,000 credit (60 days). Good for quick validation; standard shared capacity.
- Option 2 (Mini-commit, recommended): $500/month commit for 3 months (we apply first-month as credit if you sign) — effective rates ~ $0.60 per 1K generation tokens; overage at $0.78 per 1K. Includes one 2-hr onboarding session and basic observability.
- Option 3 (Milestone-backed credit): $2,500 credit in two tranches on MOU signature + integration milestone; then pay-as-you-go thereafter.

Attachments: redwood-ratecard-v2.xlsx (line-item rates by model), Nimble_MoU_20261020.pdf (sample MOU with milestone language).
